description: One NFL team's straight-up, against-the-spread and over/under record in a spot since 1999: home or road, favourite or underdog, by month (December, January), off a bye, on a short week, after a win or loss or blowout, in prime time, division games, vs one opponent, outdoors in the cold or wind, by line range. Also the lookahead spot (next week is a division game, a prime-time game, or a named rival) and the sandwich spot (a non-division game between two division games). Raw record first with n and a 95% interval, then a holds_up block: the last five seasons held out, a false-discovery correction, and an estimate shrunk by how much team spots repeat. Lists the last ten games. For 'Bills at home in December', 'Packers as road dogs', 'Chiefs after a loss', 'lookahead to Dallas', 'sandwich spot between division games', 'how do the Eagles do on a short week'.

line_min.description: Team's own line at least this (e.g. 3 = dogs of +3 or more).

lookahead.description: Next week's game: 'division', 'prime_time', or a team name (e.g. Cowboys).

sandwich.description: A non-division game with division games the week before and after.

team.description: Team: abbreviation, city or nickname, e.g. DAL, Dallas, Cowboys.

name: team_split
title: Team splits: at home, on the road, as a dog, in December, lookahead and sandwich spots
